action-compass-curate: curate the highlighted wikis on Special:Compass
apihelp-query+compass-example: Show all wikis on the form.
apihelp-query+compass-param-category: Filter by the CreateWiki defined category of a wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-customurl: Filter by if the wiki has a CreateWiki defined custom URL.
apihelp-query+compass-param-language: Filter by the CreateWiki defined language code of a wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-limit: Maximum number of results to show.
apihelp-query+compass-param-prop: Information to return about a defined wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-state: Filter by the CreateWiki defined state of a wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-wikis: Get a list of specific wikis.
apihelp-query+compass-summary: Get a list of wikis on a CreateWiki wikifarm.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-example: Show the first page of the wiki directory.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-cat: Only list wikis in this category.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-exc: Leave highlighted wikis out of the list.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-hig: Return the highlighted wikis instead of the directory.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-lan: Only list wikis in this language.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-sea: Only list wikis whose name or database name contains this text.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-sta: Only list wikis in this state.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-vis: Only list public or private wikis.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-summary: Get the wikis listed on Special:Compass.
compass-desc: Allows [[Special:Compass|discovering wikis]] on a wiki farm with [[Special:CreateWiki|CreateWiki]].
compass-error-load: The wiki directory could not be loaded. Please try again.
compass-header-info: Browse the wikis on this farm. Wikis appear here once they have opted in.
compass-label-description-help: Shown on this wiki's card on Special:Compass. Plain text only.
compass-label-extended-description-help: Shown when a reader expands this wiki's card on Special:Compass.
compass-label-visible-help: Wikis are not listed in the public directory until this is checked.
compass-results-empty: No wikis match the selected parameters.
compasscurate-add-help: Enter the database name of the wiki to highlight, for example examplewiki.
compasscurate-error-full: The maximum of {{PLURAL:$1|$1 highlighted wiki|$1 highlighted wikis}} has already been reached.
compasscurate-error-nowiki: There is no wiki with the database name "$1".
compasscurate-intro: Wikis highlighted here are shown as pinned cards at the top of [[Special:Compass]]. Wikis that have opted out of being listed are not shown.
compasscurate-success-saved: The highlighted wikis have been updated.
randomwiki-header: Choose a category and language below and on submission, you will redirected to a random wiki which meets the criteria selected.
right-compass-curate: Curate the highlighted wikis on Special:Compass
